name: Ignis Carbunculus
original_name: イグニス・カリブンクルス
source:
A magic beast from the Beast World 'Bestia'. He's made his name as the strongest there, he's a werewolf that can control fire.
He's belligerent and quarrelsome and has a short temper, but between all the non-humans he has the most common sense and he has a strong sense of duty.
He has a blunt kind of kindness.
He has a big appetite and is always coming in to the cafe to order food, his favorite is meat dishes.
